content:
**No, you cannot purchase them from that supplier.**

### Why:
1. **Food-Contact Item:** The 5-litre silicone gasket (`GSK-SIL-05L`) is classified as a food-contact part in the item master.
2. **Policy Requirements:**
   - Under **POL-PUR-001 §6.2**, parts that come into contact with food (specifically including gaskets) may be purchased **only** from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and verified before the first order is placed.
   - Under **POL-SUP-003 §4.1**, any supplier providing parts that come into contact with food must hold a food-grade certificate (such as a test report from an FSSAI-notified laboratory or accredited facility under §4.2).

Even if their pricing is significantly better, Bahi and Rasoi purchase policy strictly prohibit ordering food-contact components from suppliers without a valid, verified food-grade certificate. If you wish to use this supplier, they must first provide an accredited food-grade test report/certificate to be uploaded and approved in Bahi before any orders can be placed.

### Critical Hold on Release
Under **POL-SUP-003 §4.7**, *Bahi does not programmatically block order creation for expired certificates; the check must be enforced by purchase staff*.

Under **POL-PUR-001 §6.2** and **POL-SUP-003 §4.5**:
> *"Parts that come into contact with food... may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi... An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no food-contact part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked."*

Furthermore, per **AMD-SUP-2026-02 §1.1**, the renewed certificate must have been issued within the last 12 months and be valid for at least 60 days past the order date.
